summary: ```markdown # CLO 2025.0 - Mode & Editor This document outlines the key features and updates introduced in the CLO 2025.0 version, focusing on the mode and editor enhancements. ## Introduction to the Update This video introduces the mode and editor update for CLO 2025.0. We have optimized several functions within the chess editor to enhance user experience. ## Chess Editor Access In the 2025.0 version, you can now use a shortcut key to quickly open the chess editor window. Press the letter **O** on your keyboard to open the chess editor. This functionality remains the same as in the previous version. ## Color Block Functionality When you hover your mouse over the object window on the color block of any material, a prompt text will appear using the color from the chess. The 2025.0 version builds upon this feature by adding the ability to directly switch the color of a single color block without opening the chess editor. You can also choose color blocks associated with other materials, such as buttons or names used on costumes. By clicking on the color block, you can switch to your desired color quickly. ## Fabric Visualization in Chess Editor In the chess editor, you can now directly view the front and side of the fabric. Depending on your needs, you can change or apply color and texture to a specific surface. The color block of the fabric is divided into three parts. If you select the back or side of the fabric in the option card, it will select the same material as the front. You can use the corresponding color blocks in the single-color chess editor to edit the color and texture of the front, back, and side of the fabric. The texture is differentiated by surface, with the front, side, and back of the fabric displayed from top to bottom. If the back or side materials vary from the front, only the differing surfaces will be shown as separate color blocks. For example, in chess editor 3, only the reverse settings differ from the front, leading to two distinct color blocks being displayed. ## Independent Component Editing When applying color and texture to an independent component, such as a pig's nose button, these components will now be displayed in the chess editor in a tree-shaped structure. This design facilitates easier viewing and editing. Clicking on the small arrow next to the component's name will reveal the color blocks of each component separately. By clicking on the color block, the corresponding part will be displayed in the 3D window, allowing for direct changes to its color and texture. ## User Settings Modification In previous versions, switching colors after applying other materials required the use of the control key and did not allow for modifications to the default settings. In this version, you can modify the usual applications in the user settings for greater efficiency. To do this, go to the main menu at the top, click on **User Self-Definition**, select **Other Options**, and locate **Chess Color**. Choose your preferred application for applying new materials, and set it to the link option for all chess colors. Click the close button to save your settings. ## Fabric Application Confirmation To confirm the new application setup, go to the fabric options card in the object window, click on the increase button to create a new fabric, and then drag this fabric to the pocket panel. A tool hint will indicate that the link option we just selected is activated. After clicking update, the new fabric will apply to all chess colors, maintaining the link. Note that this application option will persist even after restarting the software. ## Enhanced Material Arrangement With the optimized chess editor in the 2025.0 version, you can easily and efficiently create and edit chess costumes. You can arrange materials more freely, allowing for changes to the original fabric's pattern while keeping the current pattern results. To demonstrate this, switch to the cherry blossom release mode, where you can see that the dress's large fabric has been finished. For patterned fabrics, you may want to retain the current pattern result after referencing the text. By switching to denim fabric, you can adjust the pattern settings. The design will be transparent from front to back. Long-pressing the original pattern function reveals two patterns currently supported: the front and back fabrics of the pattern. After completing the pattern on the front fabric, switch back to your patterned fabric to see that the original pattern result is retained. ## UV Editing Mode In the new version, the UV editing mode has transitioned to a UV editor, streamlining operation steps and optimizing workflow. A new UV expansion function has also been added to display and prepare the texture of the back and sides of fabrics. ### Operating the UV Editor In the UV editor window, locate the UV coordinate position of the leather fabric. You will notice that the front, back, and sides of the leather differ. Select all leather sheets applied and find the UV expansion in the property editor. Below the UV expansion, options for the back and sides will be available. When you select the back, the chosen sheet will display the texture of the leather's back. Selecting the side will display the texture of the leather's side. If the UV editor does not display the back and side textures after selecting the UV expansion, ensure that the thick texture surface of the 3D window is enabled. Next, select all sheets to automatically fill in the UV. ### Preparing Back and Side Textures To prepare the back and side textures of the leather, click on the back and side texture options in the toolbar on the right side of the UV editor. As before, you can set the storage path and UV area of the UV texture in the corresponding window and select the texture type you need. Click **Save** after configuring your settings. ### Important Notes on UV Layout Please note that when downloading customized clothing files in lower versions, the UV expansion is defaulted to closed to maintain the existing UV layout. Forcing it open may inadvertently reveal previously hidden UVs, potentially disrupting the expected UV layout. If the applied fabric possesses the same back and side texture but varies on the side, you can select the side only. This function applies to 3D files of wool, leather, and other fabrics. ## Conclusion The updates in CLO 2025.0 significantly enhance the user experience, allowing for more flexible and efficient editing of chess costumes. The introduction of the UV editor and simplified color application processes will enable users to work more effectively in their creative endeavors. ```
